"import cadquery as cq

# Hard-coded parameters (mm)
outer_radius = 40.0   # outer diameter 80
inner_radius = 25.0   # bore diameter 50
height = 25.0         # height along Z

# Build a hollow sleeve as a single solid:
# an annular (ring-shaped) profile extruded along +Z from z=0.
sleeve = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(outer_radius)
    .circle(inner_radius)
    .extrude(height)
)

# Export the single solid to the current working directory
cq.exporters.export(sleeve, "part.step")"
